main_text.p: idem est quod recens seu novus a um. Sic virgo dicitur musta opponitur vidua, & juventus musta die frische jugend. Grace a dulcedine.
Γλυκὺς εῖα ὑ dulcis e, Jac.3.11. in Genit. γλυ-κέῳ εἴας ἰῷ. comp. γλυκύτερῳ.
Γλῶσσα vel Attice γλῶτια ης ἡ lingua, Marc.7. v.33. fermo, Actor.2.4. fermo peregrinus, 1.Cor.14.14. γλώσσαις ὧν οἱ fermones peregrini, Act.19.6.
Γλωσσοκομιον ἡ τὸ proprie est theca lingulis tibiarum recondendis idonea. item marsupium ab externa forma. ex γλῶσσα & κομίω vel κομίζω fero, Job.12.6.
Γναφεὺς ἰῷ ὁ fullo, Marc.9.3. vide supra ἀγναφῷ.
Γνήσιῳ ὑ ὁ ἡ q.d. γνήσιῳ genuinus a, 2.Corinth.8.8.
Γνόφῳ ὑ ὁ caligo, tenebra, turbo. Eustath. ἀνέφῳ nubes, nebula, quasi νόφῳ, & assumpto γ ex Æolica dialecto, γνόφῳ, Heb.12.18.

Γνωρίζω notum facio, scio, Philip.1.21. ὑ γνωρίζω ignoro. (à nomine γνωρισμὸς ὑ ὁ ἡ notus a. γνωρισμώτερῳ notior. Hinc pro γνωρισμίζω est γνωρίζω. γνώρισμος vero dicitur pro γνώσιμῳ ex γινώσκω) F. γνωρίσω & Attice γνωρίω, Coloss.4.9. P. ἐγνώρισα. aor.1. ἐγνώρισα. a.1.act. infin. γνωρίσαι notum facere. part. a.1. γνωρίσας αὐτὸς ὁ qui notum fecit.

page.notes: Right margin notes are cut off and only partly legible; they are not transcribed. Several Greek words are uncertain given the scan quality; the Greek accents and breathings in the entries are approximate.
